Regulator-filed official copy: DraftKings Massachusetts Sportsbook House Rules, implementation date 2026-10-07, https://massgaming.com/wp-content/uploads/DraftKings-House-Rules-10.7.26.pdf, retrieved 2026-11-25 11:32:22 CST, sha256 7212c28de380e5466aa50deb2aae15d27003e1a8a6f4d7bfc2f0da4fb099e72a. Section C.ii matches the CMS wording.

Section C.ii: except for Futures Markets, if a bet is on a market with only two Selections, Tie or Draw is not offered as a Selection when the bet is accepted, and the outcome is a tie or draw, the bet is settled as Push. Market Rules define a 2-Way Moneyline the same way. If Tie or Draw is a Selection, that selection wins and the others lose. Sport-specific rules can still apply; the captured market contract must be verified.

This PR does not edit models/nba/sportsedge_nba_model.py, the Nov 15 freeze, the Nov 18 transition manifest, or verify_versioned_transition.py. Unified multi-hop verification remains a reviewed change on #535. Synthetic bit-identity and ESPN period-tie rates are not forecast-quality evidence and are not quote authentication.
